تستذكرون (form X)
# تَسْتَذْكِرُونَ (tastaḏkirūna) /tas.tað.ki.ruː.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past active indicative of اِسْتَذْكَرَ (istaḏkara)
# تُسْتَذْكَرُونَ (tustaḏkarūna) /tus.tað.ka.ruː.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive indicative of اِسْتَذْكَرَ (istaḏkara)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
